full_judgment: 4. Thereupon, the respondent Nos. 1-121, who are plaintiffs in Other Class Suit No. 105 of 1998, filed Civil Revision No. 1262 of 2005 challenging the aforesaid judgment and order dated 23.2.2005. A Single Bench of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order dated 29.5.2007 made the rule absolute refusing to stay the operation of the said compromise decree stating that the decree obtained after a long fight of 41 years in Other Class Suit No. 105 of 1998 is not liable to be stayed when the plaintiffs of the Other Class Suit No. 15 of 2004 will have the remedy under section 144 of the code of Civil. Procedure for getting back their property if it is so held in their suit.
